m4ker: The new lieutenant gave his name as Leopold Ker. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
vitto_roma07: Wendel Roma found a place in S-F7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Wendel Roma looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Wendel Roma added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
